title: Video Editor (crypt.online)
description: We're opening a new Documentary channel over on YouTube called @crypt.online and are looking for an experienced Video Editor. See all requirements below. You'll be editing approx. 2 long-form Documentaries a month
requirements: 3+ Years of experience in Premiere Pro and After Effects
Ability to edit Documentary style videos (akin to Johnny Harris, Christophe Haubursin)
Ability to take a blank video with Audio laid over and edit with pacing and rhythm
application_requirements: Are you open to a 30-second trial? (You'll be paid if we accept you)
